reason: I forget my vitamins on the counter half the time and I travel a lot, so a pre-counted sachet I can throw in my bag is exactly my problem. The lab report behind the QR code and the empty-box guarantee make one box at $24.99 an easy risk to take.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux ($23) or Goli ($19) and those last longer. I'm paying extra for the sachet format and I'm not sure I'd keep doing it every month.
would_change_my_mind: If the full price stayed above $29.99 with no launch deal I would skip it and keep buying the cheaper bottle.
